notes.subject: mooadi
notes.rationale: בר: 'mooadi' (yo a tlaqwago bogoši), 'morwa', goba 'bohlale' (Aramikeng) — bakgodi ba fapana kudu; JPS e re 'dira tumelo ka bohlale'.

notes.subject: Lokolang
notes.gloss: נשקו e bolela 'go noša/lowa' — sebopego sa go boela letšatšing; 'Lokolang' ke go fokoša tumelo ya molomo.

notes.subject: bogale bja gagwe
notes.rationale: אפו ke 'sefofane sa gagwe' — Seheberu se bolela bogale ka sefofane; seswantšho se phologile.

notes.subject: Mahlatse bohle
notes.rationale: Seswantšho sa mafelelo se bitša mmadi go šireletša go yena — sefokodi sa thabo.

translation: Lokolang mooadi, peleng a sekamela ka bogale gomme le laše tsela, ka gobane bogale bja gagwe bo tla fišwa ka mo nyenyane. Mahlatse bohle ba itšhireletšago go yena.
